topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I was sorting through old papers in the back of my classroom when I spotted a small, wrapped box on the corner of my desk, almost hidden from view. It was wrapped simply, with a note attached that read, "To the most inspiring teacher I've ever had." My heart swelled as I recognized the handwriting of a former student, someone whose growth and passion for learning I had nurtured over the years. Inside, I found a beautifully crafted book of poetry, marked with favorite pages and a signed dedication from the author. The note inside the cover read, "Thank you for believing in me and for teaching me to believe in myself." Moments like these remind me why I chose this path.
